events.content:
Implemented the gallery transitions.

- Matching `product-${slug}` boundaries now morph each grid tile into its detail view in [ProductGrid.tsx](/workspace/app/ProductGrid.tsx:1) and [[slug]/page.tsx](/workspace/app/product/[slug]/page.tsx:1). The app currently represents product images as colored tiles, so those tiles morph.
- Grid links use forward motion and the detail page’s back link uses reverse motion. Both pages apply directional transitions in [page.tsx](/workspace/app/page.tsx:1) and [[slug]/page.tsx](/workspace/app/product/[slug]/page.tsx:1).
- Suspense skeletons exit as their content enters. Reduced-motion settings disable view-transition animations and the skeleton pulse in [globals.css](/workspace/app/globals.css:1).
- Updated React and React DOM to 19.3.0 because the installed Next.js guide requires React 19.3 for `ViewTransition`; the previous runtime did not export it.

I did not run tests or a build.
